snapshot.title: Apply 10% Francs bonus + extra XP for pre-classified TESS discoveries
snapshot.description: If a player classified a TESS PC target as 'planet' before visiting it, they should earn a 10% Francs bonus and extra XP at mission debrief. This rewards the citizen science loop.

acceptanceCriteria.text: MissionDebrief checks RocketsManager for a 'planet' classification on the returned mission target
If found, net payout is multiplied by 1.1 (10% bonus)
add_experience is called once extra with reason 'tess_discovery'
Debrief status text includes 'Discovery bonus: +10% applied' so player knows why
Bonus only triggers once per target (cleared after debrief)

changes.newValue:
## Summary
- MissionDebrief._sell(): after calibrate_onboarding_payout, checks get_tess_classification(target_id)
- If verdict=="planet": net+=int(net*0.1), discovery_bonus=true, clear_tess_classification(target_id)
- add_experience(1, "tess_discovery") called on app controller
- Status text includes "Includes +10% discovery bonus for classifying this TESS target\!"
